_source: https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Tool_Leprechaun, read 2026-09-18. Everything here is a fact about OSRS written down BEFORE the content was built, so the battery compares the server with the wiki rather than with itself.
_capacity_note: The wiki's list, verbatim: 100 rakes, 100 spades, 100 seed dibbers, 100 pairs of secateurs or magic secateurs, 100 gardening trowels, 1 watering can (any water level) or Gricoller's can, 1 bottomless compost bucket, 1000 plant cures, 1000 empty buckets, 1000 buckets of compost, 1000 buckets of supercompost, 1000 buckets of ultracompost.
_magic_secateurs: The wiki's 'magic secateurs' are fairy_enchanted_secateurs (7409) here. osrs_items.obj also declares a magic_secateurs (8109) that came in with a later-cache import and that nothing wires - tools/poh_battery.py exists partly to keep anything from naming it, and the farming speed bonus reads the 7409 one.
_variants: The watering can slot takes any of watering_can_0..8 and the bottomless bucket slot takes either bottomless_bucket or bottomless_bucket_filled, because OSRS stores 'a watering can (any water level)' and one bucket whichever state it is in. Both are capped at one ACROSS their variants, not one each.

not_in_this_cache.ultracompost: a 2019 OSRS item; there is no ultracompost obj and no ultracompost content on this server, so the slot is not invented
not_in_this_cache.gricollers_can: same - a Farming Guild reward with no content here

behaviour.noted_deposits: 'Noted versions of these items can be stored as long as there is space available' - so a deposit goes through inv_moveitem_uncert and a noted stack stores as the plain item.
behaviour.withdraw_as_note: 'right-click the item in storage to withdraw as a note' - an op on the slot, not a mode toggle.
behaviour.deposit_all: The interface has a Deposit-all that 'immediately deposits all storable items at once' (added June 2026).
behaviour.one_store: There is ONE store, not one per patch: he holds your tools anywhere in the world.
behaviour.fills_can: He fills a watering can to full, which the server already did before this round.
behaviour.notes_produce: Using farming produce on him exchanges it for banknotes, which the server already did before this round.

legacy._note: The store this replaces: bit-packed counts in one varp, three bits per tool, so a maximum of SEVEN of each, and only rake/dibber/spade were ever reachable from the dialogue. The bits, as farming.varp documented them: 0-2 rakes, 3-5 seed dibbers, 6-8 spades, 9-11 gardening trowels, 12-14 secateurs, 15-18 watering can (0 = none, 1..9 = a can holding 0..8 doses).
